1 . (,ESTAT: - The Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate
Tribunal is an Appellate authority established under Customs Act,
1962 to hear various appeals under the Customs Act, 1962, Central
Excise Act, 1944 and Finance Act, 1994. The principal bench of
CESTAT is situated at New Delhi and its other Benches are situated
at Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore, Ahmedabad, Allahabad,
Chandigarh and Hyderabad. A person, on selection, may be
posted at any of the Benches of the Tribunal.

3. Qualification: - The qualifications, eligibility, salary & other terms &
conditions of the appointment of a candidate will be governed by the
provision of the Tribunal Reforms Act, 2026 read with National
Tribunals Commission and Qualification, Selection, and Conditions of
Service of Chairperson and Members of Tribunals Rules, 2026.
In terms of the National Tribunals Commission and Qualification,
Selection, and Conditions of Service of Chairperson and Members of
Tribunals Rules, 2026 , in CESTAT, a person shall not be qualified for
appointment as Member unless he/she:
Member (Judicial):
(i) is, or has been, a District Judge and Additional District Judge for a
combined period of ten years; or
(ii) has been an advocate for ten years with substantial experience in
litigation under indirect tax laws before CESTAT or High Court or the
Supreme Court; or
(iii) is, or has been, a member of the Indian Legal Service in Grade I
or above.
,Member (Technical): is, or has been, a member of the Indian
Revenue Service (Customs and Indirect Taxes Group 'A’), has held
the post of Principal Commissioner of Customs or Central Excise, or
an equivalent or higher post, and has performed judicial, quasi-judicial
or adjudicating functions for three years.
In terms of the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2026, a person holding or has
held the post of Member in CESTAT shall be eligible for consideration
for reappointment in accordance with Section 14 of the Act.
The cut-off date for considering eligibility of the ,eandidates
applicatiQn.
4 . Salary and Terms of Appointment: - A Member shall be paid a
salary of Rs. 2,25,000/- (fixed) and shall be entitled to draw allowance
as are admissible to a Government of India Officer holding Group 'A’
post carrying the same pay. In case of a person appointed as the
Member, is in receipt of any pension, the pay of such person shall be
reduced by the gross amount of pension drawn by him.
In terms of the National Tribunals Commission and
Qualification, Selection, and Conditions of Service of
Chairperson and Members of Tribunals Rules, 2026, where the
+b
person appointed as a Member of the Tribunal is a serving Judge
of the Supreme Court or a High Court or a serving Member of
any service of the Central Government or State government or
their undertaking, he shall either resign or obtain voluntary
retirement from his parent service before joining the Tribunal.
The Members of the Tribunal shall not be entitled for
additional pension, provident fund and gratuity for the services
rendered in the Tribunal.
The Mernber shall hold office for a term of five years or till he
attains the age of Sixty-Seven years, whichever is earlier,
